comment: North Carolina pilot AOIs. Imagery is exported from the NC OneMap Orthoimagery image service at 0.30 m to match SpaceNet/LoveDA. Footprints come from the NC statewide (NCEM) county files. Raleigh/Durham are the in-region train/val areas; Charlotte is a held-out city for cross-city evaluation. NOTE: footprint vintages (Wake/Durham 2021, Mecklenburg 2023) may be older than the newest imagery -- run the overlay QA in check_data.py before trusting a chip.
imagery_service_note: Orthoimagery_Latest = most recent flight per location, statewide. The single-cycle service Orthoimagery_20242027 covers only the eastern flight block -- Charlotte exports from it are blank (verified 2026-11-02), so do not use it for western NC. Because 'Latest' mosaics different flight years, always check the tile's overlay QA against the footprint vintage.
